mapper.sql: select l.id, l.request_no, l.batch_no, l.service_mode, l.entry_type, l.company_id, c.company_name, l.query_type, cast(l.query_params as char) as query_params, l.fee, l.billing_month, l.result_status, l.fee_snapshot, l.price_config_id, l.settlement_id, l.status, l.request_time, l.request_ip, l.remark from biz_query_log l left join biz_insurance_company c on l.company_id = c.id
mapper.insert: insert into biz_query_log ( request_no, batch_no, service_mode, entry_type, company_id, query_type, query_params, fee, billing_month, result_status, fee_snapshot, price_config_id, settlement_id, status, request_time, request_ip, remark ) values ( #{requestNo}, #{batchNo}, #{serviceMode}, #{entryType}, #{companyId}, #{queryType}, #{queryParams}, #{fee}, #{billingMonth}, #{resultStatus}, #{feeSnapshot}, #{priceConfigId}, #{settlementId}, #{status}, sysdate(), #{requestIp}, #{remark} )
